visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for floating bottom bars (Draft Review) and sticky navs. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Avoid in Personal track. Use subtle drop shadows for depth: shadow-sm border border-stone-200
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a 2% opacity SVG grain overlay on the Personal Track background to remove the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft radiuses. rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for major containers, rounded-full for pills and chips.

TrackChoiceScreen.layout: 100vh flex-center, bg-background. 2-card Bento-style selector (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 p-6 max-w-4xl).

cards.personal: Light background, warm borders. Icon: Magic Wand. Copy: 'Personal Track - Build a full app just by describing it. No code required.' Button: 'Start Building'
cards.developer: Dark IDE background, monospace font accents. Icon: Terminal. Copy: 'Developer Track - Full control, connect repos, advanced settings.' Button: 'Enter Workspace'

TrackChoiceScreen.micro_interaction: Hovering a card scales it slightly (scale-105) and increases shadow, fading the other card to 50% opacity.

PersonalTrackHome.layout: Generous spacing. py-32 px-6 max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col items-center text-center.

hero_prompt.design: Massive input area. text-2xl or text-3xl placeholder. Auto-resizing textarea. Bottom-right embedded submit button (arrow-right icon).
hero_prompt.surface: Solid white background, deeply rounded (rounded-3xl), rich ambient shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-stone-200/50), subtle border.

example_chips.design: Below the prompt. Staggered flex wrap layout.
example_chips.pills: rounded-full bg-stone-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors.
example_chips.micro_interaction: Clicking a chip types its text into the big prompt with a simulated keystroke animation.

DraftReviewScreen.layout: Split screen (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 p-8 h-[calc(100vh-80px)]).

left_panel_file_tree.design: Non-technical file tree. Use clear folders (🎨 Frontend, 🗄️ Database, ⚙️ Logic) instead of raw paths (src/components). Nodes must be collapsible, padded (p-2), with hover highlights.

right_panel_preview.design: Markdown-rendered README. Gives the user confidence their app structure makes sense.
right_panel_preview.surface: bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 border border-stone-200 overflow-y-auto

bottom_action_bar.design: Sticky glassmorphism bar at the bottom. flex justify-between items-center. Left: 'Regenerate', Right: 'Ship It 🚀' (Terracotta primary button).

ShipProgressScreen.timeline: 4-step vertical visual timeline (Creating repo -> Deploying -> Database -> Live).
ShipProgressScreen.active_step: Pulse animation on the active node. Text is bold and dark. Secondary text (honest states) updates below it.
ShipProgressScreen.completed_step: Turns Moss Green (#81B29A) with a Check icon.
ShipProgressScreen.micro_interaction: Heartbeat pulse on active node. Plain-language random status toasts (e.g., 'Warming up the servers...'). NEVER show stack traces.

SuccessScreen.primary_card: Massive 'Live URL' card. Crystal glass style, large text. 'your-app.fly.dev' (example).
SuccessScreen.actions: Secondary buttons: 'View Code on GitHub', 'View Database'.

DeveloperNudge.design: Ambient, dismissible banner at the top of the developer dashboard. 'Try Personal Track — build without code'. Light contrast to stand out against dark mode.

micro_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 20 to y: 0) using framer-motion.
micro_interactions.buttons: Hover: translate-y-[-2px] and slightly increased shadow. Active: scale-95.
micro_interactions.typing_effect: Used on example chips moving to input.

guidelines: Honest progress tracking ('Setting up your database...' instead of 'Running migration scripts...')

examples.error: Hmm, something got tangled up. Let's try that again.
examples.success: Your app is live to the world!

accessibility.keyboard_nav: All inputs, buttons, and file tree nodes must have visible focus-visible rings (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).
accessibility.aria_labels: Use aria-live='polite' on the Ship Progress screen for screen readers to hear status changes.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for text-bearing overlays.

instructions_to_main_agent: Phase 6: You must build the Track Chooser screen at signup.
Ensure 'dev_users' has a 'track' field ('developer' | 'personal'). Backfill existing users with 'developer'.
Implement the Personal Track React components with the warm, light theme.
Use framer-motion for the timeline pulsing and staggered file tree reveal.
Use shadcn/ui components but strip the Vercel-look by overriding tailwind classes (rounder corners, warmer borders).
Settings page must include a 'Switch to Developer Mode' with a confirmation modal.
DO NOT show stack traces on the UI in Personal track, catch errors and show plain-language Sonner toasts.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_system: Do not converge towards generic SaaS aesthetics. Use the requested padding scales (generous, 2-3x normal).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: NEVER use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (opacity, transform, background-color).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.alignment: Do NOT apply universal text-align: center on the App container.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.shadows: Use layered ambient shadows. Drop shadows should tint towards the background hue.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react. Do NOT use emojis as UI icons unless specifically for the non-technical file tree markers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: Always attach data-testid per the conventions above.
